reviewer_notes: Q12: must have taken is the conventional deduction, although an empty locker alone cannot prove Lan took her bag; specify that the bag was in the locker before departure. Q16: rough is the normal collocation, but generous could also describe an intentionally high estimate; specify approximate rather than exact and replace generous. Q27-28 both test for immediately adjacent to each other; diversify one. Q31-50: strengthen passage-specific distractors, especially Q31, Q34, Q38, Q39, Q43 and Q46. Q37-39 all D, Q48-50 all B; consider local key variety.
